## 变更内容 / Changes

说明新增、修正或移除的项目，以及它帮助团队完成的工作。

Describe the addition, correction, or removal and the work it helps a team do.

## 依据 / Evidence

- 官方文档或作者来源 / Official or author source:
- 团队使用场景 / Team use case:
- 是否实测及与项目的关系 / Experience and affiliation:

## 检查 / Checklist

- [ ] 已阅读贡献指南并检查分类及重复项 / Read the contribution guide and checked categories and duplicates.
- [ ] 项目身份、链接与简介一致 / Verified identity, official links, and descriptions.
- [ ] 中英文已同步，或已注明需要翻译协助 / Updated both languages or requested translation help.
- [ ] 已检查目录、文件链接和新增外链 / Checked contents, file links, and new external links.
- [ ] `git diff --check` 通过，未混入私有资料 / Passed whitespace checks and excluded private material.
